title: The Diamond Age
author: Neal Stephenson
summary: In a future of nanotechnology and neo-Victorian enclaves, an engineer steals an interactive book meant for a rich girl. It ends up with Nell, a poor child, whose education changes her life.
readIf: you like dense, inventive near-future worldbuilding with ideas about education and class.
skipIf: you want a tidy, tightly plotted story with a satisfying ending.
